questions.passage: While reading this novel, I was mentally transported to Darlington Hall and the events of the 1930s and the early 1940s. For the first time, I wondered, could my dedication to something turn out to be completely misguided and harm humanity more than help? questions.prompt: What new concern did reading the novel prompt in the author?

Whether every act of dedication necessarily benefits humanity.
Whether he should become a British butler immediately.
Whether his own dedication could be misguided and do more harm than good.
questions.promptZh: 读小说使作者产生什么新忧虑？

自己的奉献是否也可能方向错误，害处大于益处。
analyses: A mentally transported 是想象进入故事，不是亲自去过的记录。
B 将 could 的个人疑问改成普遍必然，还偏离具体自我反省。
C 没有改行决定。
